subject: Media Literacy
title: The Future of News
description: A quick win: understand The Future of News.

hook.text: AI can now write news articles in seconds. It can also fabricate them with equal ease.

buildup.text: Newsrooms are experimenting with AI for summaries and data analysis, freeing reporters for deeper work.

discovery.text: But AI-generated news lacks accountability — when AI makes a mistake, who's responsible?

twist.text: The future likely combines human judgment with AI efficiency — but trust will depend on transparency.

climax.text: News literacy will only become more critical as the line between human and machine content blurs.

punchline.text: AI writes faster. Humans verify better. We need both.

quiz.question: What is the main challenge with AI-generated news?
options: It lacks accountability when errors occur
